children: Samsara Inc. reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $508.44M, a 29.9% increase from $391.48M a year earlier, and net income of $16.24M compared with a loss of $16.8M in the prior-year quarter; diluted EPS was $0.03 versus ($0.03) a year ago.
¹ Reported as “Revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss)”. ³ Reported as “Net income (loss) per share, basic and diluted”.
Revenue growth of 30% year-over-year was driven by new customer additions and expansion with existing clients; year-to-date revenue reached $987.3M.
Annual recurring revenue (ARR) reached $2.125B with 3,605 customers contributing more than $100K in ARR, indicating deeper penetration in large accounts.
Company continued investments in sales, marketing, partner ecosystem, and new Applications/Agents to support adoption and expansion.
Operational investments increased in R&D and platform infrastructure, including AI tooling and cloud capacity, alongside hires to scale device, cloud, and support operations.
Strong operating cash flow and free cash flow underpin ongoing growth investments and international expansion.
